source: L2 sits deeper in the hierarchy and is shared across the ZXNAME0000XZ rather than belonging to one ZXNAME0001XZ. Nsight describes it as the cache between on-chip memory clients and device memory, and reports L2 requests, sectors, hit rate, throughput, and misses that continue to device, system, or peer memory.[3]
zh: L2 位于层次结构的较深处，并在 ZXNAME0000XZ 之间共享，而不是属于一个 ZXNAME0001XZ。 Nsight 将其描述为片上内存客户端和设备内存之间的缓存，并报告继续发送到设备、系统或对等内存的 L2 请求、扇区、命中率、吞吐量和未命中率。 [3]
